chapterInfo.content:
16
Ɛtoɔ a wɔyi kɔma Yerusalem asafo no mu ahiafoɔ
1 # Aso 11.29; 2 Ko 8; 9; Gal 2.10 Na ɛfa ɛtoɔ a wɔde kɔma ahotefoɔ no ho deɛ, sɛdeɛ mehyehyɛɛ no Galatia asafo mu no, mo nso monyɛ saa ara. 2#Aso 20.7 Daa, nnawɔtwe no mu da a ɛdi kan no, mo mu biara mfa deɛ ɛbɛsi no yie ama no anya no nsie, na mamma ansa na wɔayi toɔ no. 3Na menya me ba a, mɛma wɔn a mode nwoma bɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔfata no de mo ayɛyɛdeɛ no akɔ Yerusalem. 4Na sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ me nso mekɔ a, wɔne me akɔ.
Paulo adwuma nhyehyɛɛ
5 # Aso 19.21 Na metwa mu Makedonia a, mɛba mo nkyɛn; ɛfiri sɛ Makedonia na merekɔfa. 6#Rom 15.24 Na ebia mɛtena mo nkyɛn, anaasɛ mɛdi awɔberɛ nso mo nkyɛn, na baabiara a mɛkorɔ no moagya me kwan. 7#Aso 18.21; 20.2 Na mempɛ sɛ meretwa mu nko ara na mehunu mo, na m’ani da so sɛ Awurade ma ho kwan a, mɛdi mo nkyɛn nna kakra. 8#Aso 19.1; 19.10 Na mɛtena Efeso akɔsi Pentekoste; 9#2 Ko 2.12; Kol 4.3; Adi 3.8 ɛfiri sɛ wɔabue ɛpono kɛseɛ a emu adwumayɛ bɛso aba ama me, na wɔn a wɔasɔre atia dɔɔso.
Timoteo
10 # 1 Ko 4.17; Flp 2.20 Na sɛ Timoteo ba a, monhwɛ na wamfa ehu ne mo antena; na ɔyɛ Awurade adwuma no bi sɛ me nso. 11#1 Ti 4.12; 1 Ko 16.6 Ɛno nti obiara mmmu no animtia, na monnya no kwan asomdwoeɛ mu, na ɔmmra me nkyɛn; na meretwɛn no ne anuanom no.
12 # 1 Ko 1.12 Na onua Apolo deɛ, matu no fo pii sɛ ɔne anuanom no mmra mo nkyɛn; nso ɔmpɛ koraa sɛ ɔba seesei, na mmom ɔnya ho deɛ a, ɔbɛba.
Nsɛm ne nkyea a wɔde wie
13 # Efe 6.10 Monwɛn, monnyina mo gyidie mu, monyɛ mmarima, momma mo ho nyɛ den. 14Monyɛ mo adeɛ nyinaa ɔdɔ mu.
15 # 1 Ko 1.16; Rom 16.5 Na metu mo fo, anuanom monim Stefano fie sɛ ɛne Akaia aba a ɛdi kan, na wɔde wɔn ho ama ahotefoɔ som no, 16#Flp 2.29 sɛ mo nso mommrɛ mo ho ase mma wɔn a wɔte saa no ne obiara a ɔyɛ adwuma no bi na ɔbrɛ mu no. 17Na m’ani gye Stefano ne Fortunato ne Akaiko ba no ho, ɛfiri sɛ monni me nkyɛn yi, wɔn na wɔabɛsi mo ananmu; 18#1 Te 5.12 na wɔama me honhom ne mo deɛ ahome. Enti monni wɔn a wɔte saa no ni yie.
19 # Aso 18.2; 18.18; 18.26; Rom 16.3; 16.5 Asafo a ɛwowɔ Asia no kyeakyea mo. Akwila ne Priska ne asafo a ɛwɔ wɔn fie no kyea mo pii, Awurade mu. 20#Rom 16.16; 2 Ko 13.12; 1 Pe 5.14 Anuanom nyinaa kyea mo. Momfa mfeano kronkron nkyeakyea mo ho.
21 # Kol 4.18; 2 Te 3.17 Me Paulo me nsam nkyea ni. 22#Gal 1.8-9 Sɛ obi mpɛ Awurade Yesu Kristo asɛm a, ɔnnue! Marana-ta (Yɛn Awurade, bra!). 23Awurade Yesu adom ne mo ntena. 24Me dɔ nka mo nyinaa Kristo Yesu mu. Amen.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɛfa ɛtoɔ a wɔde kɔma ahotefoɔ no ho deɛ, sɛdeɛ mehyehyɛɛ no Galatia asafo mu no, mo nso monyɛ saa ara. Daa, nnawɔtwe no mu da a ɛdi kan no, mo mu biara mfa deɛ ɛbɛsi no yie ama no anya no nsie, na mamma ansa na wɔayi toɔ no. Na menya me ba a, mɛma wɔn a mode nwoma bɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔfata no de mo ayɛyɛdeɛ no akɔ Yerusalem. Na sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ me nso mekɔ a, wɔne me akɔ.

Na metwa mu Makedonia a, mɛba mo nkyɛn; ɛfiri sɛ Makedonia na merekɔfa. Na ebia mɛtena mo nkyɛn, anaasɛ mɛdi awɔberɛ nso mo nkyɛn, na baabiara a mɛkorɔ no moagya me kwan. Na mempɛ sɛ meretwa mu nko ara na mehunu mo, na m’ani da so sɛ Awurade ma ho kwan a, mɛdi mo nkyɛn nna kakra. Na mɛtena Efeso akɔsi Pentekoste; ɛfiri sɛ wɔabue ɛpono kɛseɛ a emu adwumayɛ bɛso aba ama me, na wɔn a wɔasɔre atia dɔɔso.

Na sɛ Timoteo ba a, monhwɛ na wamfa ehu ne mo antena; na ɔyɛ Awurade adwuma no bi sɛ me nso. Ɛno nti obiara mmmu no animtia, na monnya no kwan asomdwoeɛ mu, na ɔmmra me nkyɛn; na meretwɛn no ne anuanom no.
Na onua Apolo deɛ, matu no fo pii sɛ ɔne anuanom no mmra mo nkyɛn; nso ɔmpɛ koraa sɛ ɔba seesei, na mmom ɔnya ho deɛ a, ɔbɛba.

Monwɛn, monnyina mo gyidie mu, monyɛ mmarima, momma mo ho nyɛ den. Monyɛ mo adeɛ nyinaa ɔdɔ mu.
Na metu mo fo, anuanom monim Stefano fie sɛ ɛne Akaia aba a ɛdi kan, na wɔde wɔn ho ama ahotefoɔ som no, sɛ mo nso mommrɛ mo ho ase mma wɔn a wɔte saa no ne obiara a ɔyɛ adwuma no bi na ɔbrɛ mu no. Na m’ani gye Stefano ne Fortunato ne Akaiko ba no ho, ɛfiri sɛ monni me nkyɛn yi, wɔn na wɔabɛsi mo ananmu; na wɔama me honhom ne mo deɛ ahome. Enti monni wɔn a wɔte saa no ni yie.
Asafo a ɛwowɔ Asia no kyeakyea mo. Akwila ne Priska ne asafo a ɛwɔ wɔn fie no kyea mo pii, Awurade mu. Anuanom nyinaa kyea mo. Momfa mfeano kronkron nkyeakyea mo ho.
Me Paulo me nsam nkyea ni. Sɛ obi mpɛ Awurade Yesu Kristo asɛm a, ɔnnue! Marana-ta (Yɛn Awurade, bra!). Awurade Yesu adom ne mo ntena. Me dɔ nka mo nyinaa Kristo Yesu mu. Amen.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
